schema_note: Machine-readable provenance for real (non-illustrative) datasets. Each entry's sha256 is over the file exactly as stored in this repo -- verify before use (see verification/verify_real_data_provenance.py). Added 2026-09-20 as the direct fix for the failure mode found in AUDIT_ROADMAP.md item 1 (Cygnus per-epoch data of unconfirmed origin): every file listed here was fetched directly from its primary source with a recorded URL, exact query, and retrieval timestamp -- never compiled from a paper description or copied from another package.

datasets.source_name: USGS Earthquake Catalog (ComCat) via the FDSN Event Web Service
datasets.license: U.S. Government work; public domain (USGS data policy).
suggested_modules: percolation (magnitude-frequency / Gutenberg-Richter as a branching-process style threshold comparison)
dynamics.early_warning (temporal clustering / critical slowing down candidate)
datasets.notes: Raw bytes as returned by the API, unmodified.

datasets.source_name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI), Climate at a Glance: Global Time Series
datasets.license: U.S. Government work; public domain (NOAA data policy).
datasets.units: Degrees Celsius, departure from the 1901-2000 average, annual (Jan-Dec) mean, global land+ocean
suggested_modules: dynamics (cubic normal form / tipping-point framing, illustrative only -- no claim that this series follows that model)
identifiability (trend estimation, profile likelihood on a fitted rate)
datasets.notes: Raw bytes as returned by NOAA, including NOAA's own '#'-prefixed header comment lines (title/units/base period), unmodified.

datasets.source_name: Our World in Data COVID-19 dataset (JHU CSSE historical compact series)
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (Our World in Data); underlying case/death counts originally from Johns Hopkins CSSE.
datasets.attribution_text: Data: Our World in Data / Johns Hopkins University CSSE COVID-19 Data Repository.
datasets.filter_applied: location == 'World' only (client-side row filter on the public source file, which covers 232 locations; the full file is much larger and available unfiltered at source_url)
suggested_modules: validation (model-vs-persistence-baseline pilot analogous to docs/cygnus_pilot.md, but with confirmed real per-row data)
datasets.notes: Header row plus only the rows where location=='World' were kept from the source file; no values were altered, estimated, or interpolated.

datasets.source_name: Our World in Data COVID-19 dataset (JHU CSSE historical compact series)
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (Our World in Data); underlying case/death counts originally from Johns Hopkins CSSE.
datasets.attribution_text: Data: Our World in Data / Johns Hopkins University CSSE COVID-19 Data Repository.
datasets.filter_applied: location in ('China','World') AND date in [2020-01-22, 2020-03-25] (client-side row filter on the same public source file as owid_covid_world_daily_2020_2023; same source file hash c07ddfe8... confirmed unchanged since 2026-09-20 retrieval)
suggested_modules: validation.covid_country_decomposition (NONSTATIONARY_ROADMAP.md package 2: decompose the World Pilot A aggregate into China vs. Rest-of-World components and test how much of the apparent effective-rate change is explained by shifting country composition vs. genuine within-component rate change)
datasets.notes: 64 dates x 2 locations = 128 rows; no values altered, estimated, or interpolated. China's first date (2020-01-22) has an empty new_cases field in the source file (kept as-is, not imputed).
